title: Rehabilitation & Exercise Therapy
description: Individualised exercise programs that build strength, control and confidence in movement.
whatItIs: Rehabilitation uses individualised exercises designed around the patient's assessment, physical capacity and goals.
howItWorks: Repeated movement and progressive loading encourage the muscles, joints and nervous system to adapt. Over time, this can improve strength, coordination, endurance, mobility and control.
howItHelps: Rehabilitation can make everyday activities easier, improve confidence in movement and help patients build the physical capacity needed for work, sport and daily activities.
